english_description: SIMud, an Apache-2.0 English LDMud-style mudlib by Allaryin, Acius, Venger, and Malap. LDMud → FluffOS conversion: archive master uses set_driver_hook and closures; this collection boots a FluffOS catalog overlay (Void + workshop look/score/quit) while keeping the full mud/ tree (rooms, races, magic, economy). Not StickLib or Age of Elements.
